title: Windows: cargo check --tests fails on master: review_freeze_cli integration test lacks normalize_user_facing_path
outcome: On Windows, `cargo check --bin termal --tests` compiles every test target on master without error, including the review_freeze_cli integration test.
acceptance: On Windows, the launcher's rust-tests compile of all test targets succeeds on the exact landed input, including review_freeze_cli and review_identity_cli if still present, shown by a registered or recorded Windows run whose source_id is equal before and after.

The fix is minimal and changes no product behaviour: the include!-ed src/test_temp_paths.rs no longer calls a binary-crate-only function in integration-test targets, or those targets provide it. No new hashing or identity.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on Windows on the exact landed input.
